action: The agent is calling the same tool with identical arguments repeatedly, usually because it isn't using or retaining the result. Add explicit context-retention instructions: "After reading a file, do not re-read it unless you have made changes." Or scope the task more narrowly so the agent can complete it without re-querying the same resource.

Verify the package/function exists before asking the agent to use it. If the error persists after 2 attempts, intervene manually rather than asking the agent to retry.

If you are using "make it pass the tests", ensure the tests are deterministic and not themselves the source of the conflict.
